Name: Azure Storage Smart Tier Remediator
Description: Can read storage accounts and their locks and update storage accounts for enable-only smart-tier automation. Note: Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/write is full account-update authority (network rules, shared-key access, TLS settings, public access and more) - there is no field-level action for accessTier. The role grants no delete, key or data-plane actions. Assign it only at the resource group(s) that contain the accounts you intend to change.
